body:
# Ender Pearl Crafting Datapack
Tired of hunting Endermen? This lightweight datapack adds a simple and balanced crafting recipe for Ender Pearls, making progression more accessible without breaking the vanilla feel. Perfect for survival and multiplayer worlds!

## Features:

- Custom recipe to craft Ender Pearls using easily configurable ingredients

- Fully vanilla-compatible, no mods required

- Plug-and-play: just drop it into your datapacks folder

Supports Minecraft 1.21.4
Balanced for gameplay – tweakable for custom servers!
